summary: The audit checks the calculus prerequisite (MATH 19, 20 or 21). The minor has no fixed course list: you move in six advisor-approved courses of at least three units each, letter graded where offered, for at least 24 units not used for your major or another minor. The prerequisite does not count toward the 24 units. You check the 2.0 GPA and the advisor-signed program sheet by hand.

totals.label: Prerequisite calculus course
totals.why: The calculus course is "The minimum prerequisite for a Civil Engineering Minor", and "A civil engineering minor must contain at least 24 units of coursework not taken for the major and consist of at least six classes": the prerequisite is not one of the 24 units.

ZCMruUsB.why: "A civil engineering minor must contain at least 24 units of coursework not taken for the major and consist of at least six classes of at least three units each of letter-graded work, except where letter grades are not offered. The list of courses must represent a coherent body of knowledge in a focused area ... obtain the advisor's approval (including signature) of their study list on the CE Minor Program Sheet". No list: the student moves the six approved courses in; their grading and units are checked with the approval.
